title: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center: Cloud Update and Inventory export improvements
notes: claim 43: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The roadmap details, Inventory export path and subscription requirements are supported. The briefing nevertheless assures administrators that the improvements need no configuration without documentation establishing that, and makes an unsupported assertion about access controls on exported files.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes no new export role, permission or change to who can see device data.
claims.quote: These enhancements will expand export capabilities across Inventory and Cloud Update device views, include additional device and update information, and allow admins to export filtered results so they can focus on the devices most relevant to their needs.

claims.claim: The record does not state that existing exports change in a way that breaks anything.
claims.quote: New export improvements are coming to Cloud Update, making it easier for organizations to access and analyze device data.

claims.claim: Export is an administrator action in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center with your admin account, and then go to Inventory in the navigation pane.

claims.claim: The improvements are optional and need no configuration.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update export improvements filtered exports enable disable default role 577398; Cloud Update export configuration enable. Read Inventory, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-prepare; none establishes the improved export's configuration requirements.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's second sentence with 'It affects administrators; review export permissions and re-test CSV consumers as it rolls out.' Replace 'even though it needs no configuration' in Why it matters with 'while Microsoft has not documented an enablement setting for the improvements'.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the improved export's default state or tenant-by-tenant arrival mechanics.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update export improvements filtered exports enable disable default role 577398. Read roadmap record, Inventory, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-prepare; no default or tenant rollout mechanics for this export improvement were stated.

claims.claim: The entitlement model is included in the subscription plans required for the existing Inventory product.
claims.quote: Your user must be assigned to one of the following subscription plans:

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Inventory requires the user to hold Microsoft 365 A3 or A5, Business Standard or Premium, Office 365 E3 or E5, or Microsoft 365 E3 or E5.
claims.quote: Education: Microsoft 365 A3, Microsoft 365 A5. Business: Microsoft 365 Business Standard, Microsoft 365 Business Premium. Enterprise: Office 365 E3, Office 365 E5, Microsoft 365 E3, Microsoft 365 E5.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Scope: Who and where
claims.claim: The Inventory page lists Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet, GCC, and GCC High and DoD plans as unsupported.
claims.quote: The following plans are not supported: Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet; Microsoft 365 GCC; Microsoft 365 GCC High and DoD

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Roles; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Inventory lists Office Apps Administrator (recommended), Security Administrator and Global Administrator for accessing and managing the feature.
claims.quote: You can use the following built-in Microsoft Entra roles for accessing and managing the feature: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended); Security Administrator; Global Administrator.

claims.claim: Global Reader is supported by the admin center but does not support some features, including cloud update.
claims.quote: Global Reader is another built-in role supported by the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, but it does not support some features like cloud update or the Modern App Settings page.

claims.claim: Cloud update requires a supported Microsoft Entra role and recommends Office Apps Administrator for least privilege.
claims.quote: Admins must have a supported Microsoft Entra role to use cloud update. Use the Office Apps Administrator role to provide the required access with least privilege.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Inventory device export is reached through Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Inventory > Devices > Show all devices > Export.
claims.quote: Go to Inventory in the navigation pane. Under Devices, choose Show all devices. To do an export, navigate to the Devices view and select the Export button.

claims.claim: No alternative script or API route is documented for the Inventory export.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory export API PowerShell Microsoft Graph alternative methods data export. Read Inventory's Export inventory views: 'Inventory doesn't support alternative methods for data export.' Results for Intune and Power Platform exports describe different products.

claims.claim: The existing Inventory export produces a .csv file for use in other tools.
claims.quote: You can export the inventory views to .csv format so that you can import your data into other tools.

claims.claim: The service prepares the Inventory export in the background.
claims.quote: This service prepares the data in the background and notifies you when it's ready for download.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The documented baseline Inventory export ignores the currently set filters.
claims.quote: Inventory always exports all data points, regardless of the currently set filters.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions: export limit
claims.claim: Inventory data can currently be exported once per day.
claims.quote: Inventory data can be exported once per day and downloaded as many times as needed.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Cloud Update Status, Update Status and Wave are not currently included in the documented Inventory export.
claims.quote: The following columns were added to inventory with the upgrade to Cloud Updates, but aren't currently included when exporting data: Cloud Update Status, Update Status, and Wave.

claims.claim: An existing cloud update Issues-tab details pane offers export of the impacted device list.
claims.quote: Selecting an issue opens a details pane with the impacted device list, an option to export that list, and a link to our troubleshooting article for Office updates.

claims.claim: Each cloud update profile's Devices tab has sort and filter controls.
claims.quote: The Devices tab (also available for each profile) provides insights for all managed devices in that profile. It includes sort and filter controls to help you narrow in on what matters most.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Inventory table includes the last user who signed into Office on the device.
claims.quote: Last user | The last user that signed into office on the device

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Inventory table includes the last signed-in user's email address.
claims.quote: Last email | The last user's email that signed into office on the device

claims.claim: Supported devices are automatically included in Inventory once a user launches Office apps.
claims.quote: Once a user launches their Office apps on a supported device, that device is automatically included in Inventory.

claims.claim: Exporting reads data and changes nothing on devices.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps cloud update export CSV device changes permissions audit export Message Center 577398. Read Inventory's export section and cloud-update-enhancements; they describe CSV generation, not an explicit guarantee of no device-side changes.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with 'The Inventory page documents export as creating a .csv file for use in other tools.'

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center roles no longer apply to CSV data outside the admin center.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps export roles csv read; Microsoft 365 Apps cloud update export CSV device changes permissions. Read Inventory and cloud-update-enhancements; neither describes the enforcement or inheritance of admin-center roles on downloaded CSV files.
claims.fix: Remove the clause 'where Microsoft 365 Apps admin center roles no longer apply'. Retain the risk analysis about exporting personal and device data and deciding storage locations and recipients.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the roadmap's filtered-export and additional-field improvements.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update export improvements filtered exports enable disable default role 577398; Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory Cloud Update export improvements licensing pricing meter charge additional fields. Read Inventory, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-prepare.

claims.claim: The Inventory page names no meter or separate charge for export.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory Cloud Update export improvements licensing pricing meter charge additional fields. Read Inventory in full, including Licensing requirements and Export inventory views; it lists subscription requirements but no export charge or meter.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence, rate or price specific to these export improvements is published in the researched Microsoft documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory Cloud Update export improvements licensing pricing meter charge additional fields. Read Inventory, cloud-update-prepare, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-requirements search excerpt; no export-improvement-specific licence, price or rate appeared.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an export-specific permission or tenant switch for enabling or disabling the improved exports.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update export improvements filtered exports enable disable default role 577398; Cloud Update export configuration enable. Read Inventory, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-prepare; general roles are documented, but no export-specific switch or permission.

claims.where: rationale: risk; Open questions: extra fields
claims.claim: The particular additional fields in the improved exports have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps Inventory Cloud Update export improvements licensing pricing meter charge additional fields. Read Inventory and cloud-update-enhancements; the record promises additional device and update information without naming the new fields.

claims.claim: The review action rating treats the change as optional rather than an arriving improvement to existing exports.
claims.quote: action: review; status: rolling-out; 'Today's Inventory export ignores filters and omits the cloud update columns'; 'Any script, spreadsheet or report that expects today's Inventory CSV columns should be re-tested once the new export reaches your tenant.'
claims.fix: Set action to 'prepare': the record describes improvements rolling out to existing export views, and the briefing identifies CSV consumers needing checks before adopting the changed output.

claims.claim: Every control the checklist asks readers to take stock of is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: 'Identify who holds the Office Apps Administrator, Security Administrator and Global Administrator roles'; the sole table row is 'Exporting the Inventory device list to a .csv file'.
claims.fix: The Before rollout step asking readers to identify role holders has no role-management control row. Remove that checklist step; the verified role requirements can remain in Scope and the export row note.

claims.claim: End users see nothing from this change.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft 365 Apps cloud update export CSV device changes permissions audit export Message Center 577398. Read Inventory, cloud-update-enhancements and cloud-update-prepare; none explicitly states that the export improvements have no end-user-visible effects.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'Low. The roadmap describes export improvements for administrators using Inventory and Cloud Update device views.' Keep the low impact rating.

claims.claim: No publicly discoverable Message Center post for the improved export was available in the researched sources.
claims.quote: Searched: 577398 export Message; Microsoft 365 Apps cloud update export CSV device changes permissions audit export Message Center 577398. Read cloud-update-enhancements and the roadmap record; no notice for this item was supplied, linked or returned.

controlChecks.governs: Exporting the Inventory device list to a .csv file
